text: Explain how media regulators are influenced by wider social issues. [15]
‘All contemporary media texts rely on the codes and conventions of postmodernism.’ To what
extent do you agree with this statement? [15]
Assess the extent to which public discourse is controlled by the media. [15]
‘Digital technology should make everyone’s access to media content equal; in fact, nothing could
be further from the truth.’ To what extent do you agree with this statement? [30]
